title: GBA ROM FanGame: Pokémon Relic Ultimate
author: balesleftpeg3
selftext:
⚡🌑 POKÉMON RELIC ULTIMATE 🌑⚡

🎮 After months of development, countless changes, new Pokémon, custom sprites and a completely reworked adventure, I'm excited to introduce Pokémon Relic Ultimate (PRU)! 

💛 Built on pokemonHnS-expansion, PRU takes you across Johto and Kanto, with new challenges, legendary encounters and a huge amount of additional content.

⚡ WHAT CAN YOU EXPECT?

🔸 450 Pokémon — including new evolutions, custom Pokémon and powerful legendary forms.

🔸 Two regions — explore Johto and Kanto, battle 16 Gym Leaders and become Champion.

🔸 The RELICS Quest — uncover the secrets of seven ancient legendary Pokémon and unlock an epic final encounter.

🔸 Elite 20 — the ultimate postgame challenge, featuring 20 increasingly difficult battles against familiar faces and legendary trainers.

🔸 Custom Pokémon & Evolutions — discover completely original creatures and redesigned favourites.

🔸 Modern Battle Mechanics — updated moves, abilities, items, new status conditions and competitive features.

🔸 Quality-of-Life Improvements — free move relearning, improved training, reusable HM functionality and much more.

🔸 Nuzlocke & Randomiser Modes — additional ways to experience the adventure,  - currently undergoing testing -

🏆 AND THERE'S MORE...

Familiar rivals, Team Rocket, legendary encounters, hidden secrets and an entirely new ending await those who can conquer everything Johto and Kanto have to offer.

🛠️ CURRENT BUILD STATUS: ALPHA 2.0

It's a huge project and there's still polishing and testing to do, so expect the occasional bug while development continues.

💬 I'd love to hear your thoughts, suggestions and feedback.

✨ 16 BADGES. 450 POKÉMON. 20 ULTIMATE BATTLES. ONE FINAL LEGEND.

Welcome to Pokémon Relic Ultimate! 🔥

⬇️ Download Alpha 2.0:

https://www.mediafire.com/file/e12tnbzc1w19zff/Pokemon\_Relic\_Ultimate\_-\_Alpha\_02.gba/file/

📒 RelicDex:

🆕 Any further updates will be uploaded directly to the About page on RelicDex.

\#PokemonRelic Ultimate #PokemonROMHack #PokemonGBA #PokemonHeartGold #PokemonFanGame #ROMHacking

🤖 NOTE FROM ME:

Just to be completely transparent, I've used AI to help code and develop this game. I don't know how to code myself, and between working full-time, having a wife, three kids and everything else that comes with family life, I simply wouldn't have the time to learn programming and build something like this from scratch. 

But that's the beauty of AI — it's a tool that allows people to bring their ideas to life in ways that previously wouldn't have been possible. The ideas, Pokémon designs, storylines, features and overall direction are mine, while AI has helped turn those ideas into a playable game.

It's still taken countless hours of planning, testing, fixing bugs and making changes. AI doesn't magically make a finished game with one prompt! I know some people aren't fans of AI, and that's absolutely fine, but for me it's made a project I've always dreamed of creating actually possible. 

At the end of the day, I'm just a Pokémon fan making something I love and hopefully something others will enjoy too! ❤️
